criterion: Required fields present; patient identifiers present; binary outcome and 0/1 group. Missing score, outcome, or group rows are counted and excluded from complete cases.
pass_route: Continue with the complete-case admission records.
fail_route: Invalid required input: not estimable; no point estimate or CI.

criterion: At least one score level is observed in both diagnosis groups.
pass_route: Continue to the point estimate on observed common support.
fail_route: No common support: not estimable; no point estimate or CI.

criterion: Compute the weighted summary Δ_w using pooled admission-record weights over the applicable support.
pass_route: Retain the point estimate while evaluating interval reportability.
fail_route: If prespecified target support is lost, retain the observed-support point estimate and withhold the population-target interval.

criterion: ≥20 records per score level; ≥10 records per score-by-definition cell; ≥20 distinct patients overall and per cell; every target cell has at least one event and one non-event, checked from exact counts.
fail_route: Retain the point estimate; withhold the CI.

criterion: Run 60 draws. A usable draw retains every score level and has ≥10 events in each diagnosis definition across support; require ≥20 usable draws.
pass_route: Emit the point estimate and the v2 interval outputs.
fail_route: Retain the point estimate; withhold the CI.

criterion: Focused cases cover prespecified support loss, exact event-count handling, and per-level interval availability under a summary refusal.
pass_route: These tests support the displayed branch semantics.
fail_route: Not a separate patient outcome or causal pathway.
